hero.title: Every order
hero.subtitle: Unitia connects restaurants with social organizations. Every order generates an automatic donation to the cause you choose to support.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple, transparent, and free to join.

steps.title: The restaurant picks a cause
steps.desc: They sign up, set up their menu and choose what percentage of each order goes to a social cause.

steps.title: Customers order as usual
steps.desc: They scan a QR or visit the restaurant link. The order generates an automatic donation, with zero friction.

steps.title: The cause receives the support
steps.desc: The restaurant sees how much they owe, transfers it, and the cause confirms. Traceable and transparent.
